title: Same EV. One Brother Lost Twice as Much Battery #shorts

scenes.text: Two brothers bought the exact same electric car. Eight years later, one of them had lost twice as much battery. So what went wrong?
Sam plugged in at home every night. It was slow, boring, and cheap.
Leo never bothered. He lived on high-power fast chargers. Ten minutes, and gone.
For years, nobody noticed a difference.
Then came year eight. Sam's battery still held about 88 percent. Leo's was down to about 76.
That's not a guess. It matches data from more than 22,000 electric cars. Heavy high-power fast charging roughly doubles battery wear.
The twist? Leo's car still drives fine. But now he has to stop and charge more often. So, is saving ten minutes worth it?
